curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with what belts do for survival, who must buckle in Virginia, how to wear a belt correctly and the physician waiver.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for who must buckle versus the waiver and for correct belt fit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on seat belt rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what to do when flagged down, how to sit during the stop, handling your documents and signing a citation.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the opening steps versus the stop posture and for paperwork versus the signature.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the child restraint waiver and fines, seating children safely, door safety and the places children may never ride.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for waivers versus fines and for the banned riding places.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on child passenger safety.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how airbags protect belted riders, seating distances, the child seat stages by age and the booster fit test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for airbag seating, seat direction by age and front-seat exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on airbags and child seats.
